title.zh: 【以太坊基金会研究员：EIP-8025 执行证明在 Sepolia 测试网实现区块实时证明】
title.en: 【以太坊基金会研究员：EIP-8025 执行证明在 Sepolia 测试网实现区块实时证明】

current_state.zh: Ethereum Foundation researcher Tau Lepton demonstrated EIP-8025 execution proofs on Sepolia, proving blocks in about 6–7 seconds on 16 RTX 5090 GPUs across ethrex and reth clients, fast enough to finish before the next 12-second block.
